name: Background Remover
description: Remove image backgrounds with a local AI model, no upload required
help: Runs a segmentation model entirely on your machine in Rust; images never leave your computer.
Download a model once: the fast model is 4.4 MB, the high-quality model 170 MB. Downloads resume if interrupted and are verified with SHA-256.
Results keep the original resolution and are saved as transparent PNGs, or composited onto a color you choose.
Works best with a clear subject such as a person, product or animal.
